method: same-entry allocation ablation, not a full strategy backtest
timing_rule: Only full candles with open >= ceil(entry/60000)*60000 and open+60000 <= original recorded exit; exclude entry-minute partial and final incomplete candle.
bar_path: Open -> adverse extreme -> favorable extreme -> close. Existing stop fills first, gaps at open; targets fill at their level; raised stop can trigger on later segments of the same bar. This is one shared conservative path assumption, not tick replay.
limitations: Paper trade sample, not real-money fills.
Only allocation changes; entries, initial risk, targets and protections held constant; no revised entry gates, structure-target planner, flow, exhaustion, trailing or halts replayed.
MTM horizons are bounded by each original exit and available candles; they are not new strategy exit signals. Entry-minute action is unobserved.
No-complete-candle and gapped streams excluded rather than assigned zero profit.
Per-trade R uses equal initial risk units; trades overlap. Sequence drawdown is not account/portfolio drawdown.
Saved pnl_r is terminal price displacement, not realized weighted profit, and is never used. Saved stop_loss can be moved; initial risk recovered from consistent target spacing.
Small selected historical sample; no out-of-sample validation or profitability guarantee.
